infobox.usage: Unlocks a storage room in warehouse #6 on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The USEC stash key (USEC) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the USEC stash, located somewhere in the Customs area.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Locations
sections.text: Door to a storage room on the first floor of warehouse #6 on Customs.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 2x Weapon box (4x4)
- 2x Wooden crate
- Metal fuel tank or Expeditionary fuel tank spawn
- Loose loot (Weapon mods)
- Possible weapon spawn (AUG A1, AUG A3, SR-25 (Taupe), Colt M16A2, Colt M16A1, M1A, G36, RFB, SCAR-L 5.56x45 and others)
